name: The Hellcat Lounge
source:
Life has many roads, it's easy to get lost. Noah was lucky though, he was happy with the road he was on. Not many find their's at twenty three, but he was sure he had. But as life tends to do, things change and he suddenly found himself pushed onto a road he'd never seen coming. But sometimes an unexpected pivot can be a good thing. Now he spends his nights tending bar and trying to get his fledgling band off the ground, bonding with his friends, and exploring the world filled with alcohol, drugs, sex Rock and Roll.

Will he find fame and fortune? Or will he stay in obscurity? Experience true love or indulge in hedonistic lust? Whatever happens you can find it all behind the doors of The Hellcat Lounge.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/WilsonWonka]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
人生有很多条路，一不小心就会迷失。诺亚很幸运，因为他一直走得顺心。很多人到了23岁还没找到人生方向，但他确信自己已经找到了。可人生总会改变，转眼间，他被推上了一条从未料到的道路。有时，意想不到的转折也可能是好事。如今，他夜里在酒吧照看生意，努力让刚起步的乐队有所起色，同时和朋友们培养感情，探索充满酒精、毒品、性爱与摇滚乐的世界。

他能否名利双收，还是会继续默默无闻？能否体验真爱，还是沉溺于纵欲享乐？无论发生什么，你都能在《地狱猫休息室》的大门之后找到答案。
